name: Clips4Sale
summary: The deepest long-tail fetish clip marketplace online: thousands of independent creator and studio stores selling individual downloads with zero mandatory subscription.
ranking_rationale: Unrivaled long-tail fetish depth—if a specific kink exists, dozens of indie stores cover it here a la carte—offset by a utilitarian storefront UI and per-clip pricing.

pricing.free_tier: Free catalog browsing and short clip previews
pricing.notes: Clips are purchased individually with no required monthly subscription; pricing is set per independent store.

pros: Deepest long-tail fetish and niche category catalog on the web
Pay only for the exact clips you want—no recurring subscriptions
Thousands of independent producers and specialized fetish studios
Direct DRM-free MP4 downloads on purchased clips
cons: Per-clip pricing gets expensive for binge viewers
Visual design and video quality vary wildly across independent stores
Preview clips are often very short
